name: Loose cotton clothing / washing sheets

lead: Loose cotton clothing and regularly washed sheets aim to reduce friction and trapped sweat, so fewer clogged follicles and body breakouts appear on the back, chest and shoulders.

Acne mechanica arises from friction, heat and pressure, and Wikipedia suggests loose-fitting breathable fabrics such as cotton over synthetics. Clothing friction is also listed as a trigger of folliculitis. No trials of the habit were found.

paras: People choose looser, breathable fabrics for daily wear and training and launder sheets and pillowcases on a regular schedule. It is often combined with showering after sweating.

angle.text: Loose, breathable cotton and regularly washed bedding reduce friction, heat and trapped sweat on the skin, so fewer follicles get clogged and body breakouts show up less. General references on acne mechanica suggest it.

lead: Wearing loose, breathable clothing such as cotton and washing bedding regularly are habits adopted to reduce friction- and occlusion-related acne.[1]

Wikipedia says acne mechanica arises from friction, heat and pressure, and suggests loose-fitting, breathable fabrics such as cotton over synthetics; the page is flagged as needing more reliable medical sources.[1] It also lists clothing friction as a trigger of folliculitis.[2]

paras: Practitioners choose loose cotton garments to limit rubbing and trapped sweat, and launder sheets and clothes frequently. The sources reviewed give no specific laundering guidance.[1]
